notes.title: Windwalker is out!
notes.content:
Windwalker is finally out! Join our community discord if you need help or have any questions, or suggestions.

We're a very small studio so we would appreciate any feedback you could provide us.

Thanks, and enjoy the game!

https://discord.gg/nnNYPdd2

notes.title: Gather your might, Windwalker is near!
notes.content:
It is time for a launch party! Rev Dev Studios is made up of best friends who worked on games together with shared goals in mind:

- Make cool games that we would play ourselves
- Use these projects as a stepping stone into the wider games industry.

This game evolved from a geospatial mobile RPG where you traverse the real world to acquire items and participate in combat into a now fully PC RPG game. We poured thousands of hours into this game, and while we won't say it's our Magnum Opus- we are proud of the game we are releasing soon.


[h2]Game Info[/h2]

[h3]Microtransactions[/h3]
None. While we had designed and implemented a system that would include microtransactions, we ultimately decided against it. Completely Free to Play!

[h3]How many classes are available?[/h3]
Every player starts as a Novice, then can branch into a Warrior, Ranger, or Mage at level 10. 
At level 30:
[b]Mage [/b]-> Necromancer | Elementalist | Priest
[b]Warrior [/b]-> Knight | Berserker | Spellsword
[b]Ranger [/b]-> Marksman | Windwalker | Beastmaster

[h3]What is the max level?[/h3]
The max level is 100.

[h3]When do I get my first Pet?[/h3]
Your first pet can be acquired from the Shop at level 10.

[h3]Is there multiplayer?[/h3]
There is no multiplayer at the moment.

[h3]I'm still lost![/h3]
See the tutorial NPC in the game for more game info.


[h1]Thank you![/h1]
